title: discaria articulata
intro: Discaria articulata, commonly known as the New Zealand knotted wood or "Tawha" in Maori, is a plant species native to New Zealand. It is a shrub with medicinal properties, traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Discaria articulata include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate symptoms associated with infections and inflammation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
